skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Unfettered
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series New Release/Unfettered. A set of children's clothes, Columbian in origin. Vulcan's reward to Ceobe for being a good girl.
skins.quote: Vulcan took out one piece of clothing after another from the bag, and Ceobe put them on one by one, but she ran away before Vulcan could take out the pants.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA333
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA333. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: She's been playing all day long and if no one comes to stop her, she'll keep playing.
